text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The training camp is coming up soon, huh. 
...Guess I'll have to say goodbye to the 
fields for a while.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm worried about the vegetables while 
we're away... If we won't be able to care 
for them for so long...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Sympathy! I thoroughly understand your 
concerns!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
However, fear not! While the students are 
away, we shall take care of the vegetables 
ourselves!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Isn't that way too tough!?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I'll help out as well. If it's an area 
about this size, we should be able to 
manage.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm! Furthermore, I have prepared a special 
secret weapon as well! Follow me!

We were guided to a parking spot where an 
absurdly futuristic car was parked. ...In 
place of wheels, it had something 
resembling thrusters.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"This is the machine built just for you 
girls... The Vege-Jet!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
This super machine delivers the grown 
vegetables at super-express speed straight 
to your training camp!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Since it's only Unit 1, it may not produce 
its usual results, but this technology is 
a world first!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
It's a groundbreaking machine developed 
solely for you students heading off to the 
training camp! Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Buying weird stuff out of her own 
pocket again...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
N-No, that's not it! This was an 
absolutely necessary expense! It was 
strictly for the sake of the students—

"Anyway, thanks to Chairwoman Akikawa and 
the others, we don't have to worry about 
the fields at all during training camp!"
